d: Tyoharon ko lekar jharkhand samet deshbhar men utsah aur bhaktimay mahaul dekhne ko mila. dipavli ke avsar par logon ne gau mata ki puja-archana kar unhen pakvanon ka bhog lagaya, vahin kali puja ke avsar par vibhinn sthanon par vishesh aarti aur dharmik anushthan aayojit kie gae. dusri or, is bar ranchi men dipavli ke dauran vayu pradushan ne pichhle panch varshon ka rikord tor diya. dipavli ki rat eyar kvaliti indeks yani ekyuaaee 882 tak pahunch gaya. is dauran shahar men do sthanon par aag lagne ki ghatnaen bhi samne aaeen, jin par kaphi mashakkat ke bad kabu paya gaya. vahin, aadivasi…
